Good to know for trades & construction

  • Hi vis compliance is as published by the manufacturer for each style. The product page names the standard where the maker states it.
  • Logos never go over reflective tape. We place them on the chest or a clear back panel instead.
  • Order shirts and cargos in matching colours so the whole crew looks the same on site.

Read our hi vis and workwear guide for logo positions, decoration methods and minimums.

1Pick garments. Choose colours and sizes on any style, or fill the Bulk Order Grid for a whole team.
2Add your logo. Upload artwork and pick embroidery, DTF or screen print, and where it goes.
3Get your quote. We check stock, confirm decoration pricing and send a quote to approve.
4Decorated and delivered. Usually 10 to 15 business days from artwork approval, plus freight.

Need help choosing? Read the decoration guide or call 1300 291 277.
